Fulton County spans the length of metro Atlanta, from the affluent office corridors of Alpharetta and Sandy Springs in the north through downtown Atlanta itself to Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport and the industrial belt of south Fulton. Two separate school systems — Atlanta Public Schools inside the city, Fulton County Schools everywhere else — split the county in a way that shows up directly in school-boundary and zoning decisions.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 31, 2026
